title: Red or green: the future on date two
caption: Date two and they bring up the future. Some questions are green. Naming the dog is not.

beats.head: Date two. They bring up *the future.*
'Do you want *kids someday?*'
beats.sub: Green. Knowing what you want is healthy.

beats.head: 'I already named *our dog.*'
beats.sub: Red. That's a fantasy, not a question.

beats.head: 'Where do you see *yourself* in five years?'
The truth: *dealbreakers* belong up front.
beats.sub: Then date two can just be fun.

beats.head: Send this to the friend who *named the dog.*
